p1_b0.ocr: In the Aftermarket service revenue table for Emerson Electric covering the period from 2019 to 2024 in Europe, the following data is presented: For the year 2019, the Service Revenue was $120M with a Growth Rate of 5%, categorized as Stable under Maintenance, and noted as the Initial Year in CHF. In 2020, the Service Revenue increased to $130M with an 8% Growth Rate, marked as Growing under Repairs, influenced by Post-COVID Impact in CHF.

p1_b1.ocr: The year 2021 saw a further increase to $140M in Service Revenue, with a Growth Rate of 7%, categorized as Growing under Parts Supply due to Supply Chain Recovery in CHF. In 2022, Service Revenue rose to $150M, reflecting a 6% Growth Rate and categorized as Growing under Field Services, driven by Increased Demand in CHF. The year 2023 recorded a Service Revenue of $160M, maintaining a 5% Growth Rate, categorized as Stable under Consulting and associated with Market Expansion in CHF.
